full_judgment:
5. Leave was granted to consider the submission that respondent No. 3 Additional Commissioner having acted in accordance with the provisions of Sub-rule (3)(a)(ii) of Rule 20 of the Municipal Corporation (Taxation) Rules 1986 in fixing monthly rent at the rate of Taka 2 per square foot of bank's said holding and the same being just and reasonable and the bank having failed to produce any scrap of paper to show that the same was excessive or high, the High Court Division erred in law in disturbing the said assessment and the submission that High Court Division having observed that the Miscellaneous Appeal No. 10 of 1990 having been filed beyond the prescribed period under Sub-rule (13) of Rule 7 of the said Taxation Rules acted illegally in making the Rule absolute without considering Annexure-IV of the affidavit-in-opposition wherein specific objection was raised about limitation and with-out considering that the said Taxation Rules is a special law relating to special subject and it has created special forum for appeal. 

 14. He lastly submitted that the Sonali Bank did not make the authority within time prescribed by Rules fixing annual value and, as such, their claim is barred by limitation. 

 15. Since we have decided that the valuation of the holding in question is to be assessed on the basis of 12 months' annual rental minus two months' rent as maintenance allowance for the building, as per provisions of Rule 20(3)-(a)(ii), in our view, the question of limitation as raised by Mr. Alam has lost its force. In our view, for the above reasons, the High Court Division did not rightly give any decision on the question of limitation.
